This Pacifica came in for one simple reason: the previous owners were ready to move into something newer. That left us with a local trade that still has a lot going for it, especially if you need real family space without spending new van money. This 2017 Chrysler Pacifica Touring L Plus has 68,842 miles and is finished in Velvet Red Pearl over a Black and Alloy interior.

The Touring L Plus is where the Pacifica starts getting really comfortable. You get leather seating, heated front seats, heated second row seats, a heated steering wheel, power front seats, and Chryslers incredibly useful Stow n Go second and third row seating.

That Stow n Go system is one of the biggest reasons people keep coming back to the Pacifica. Fold the seats into the floor when you need cargo room, bring them back up when passengers are coming along, and do it without removing heavy seats from the vehicle.

This one is also equipped with the Uconnect Theater Package, giving the rear passengers dual 10.1 inch HD seatback screens, Blu ray and DVD capability, wireless headphones, remote controls, USB video input, and a 13 speaker Alpine premium audio system.

Family convenience keeps going with hands free sliding doors, a hands free power liftgate, remote start, keyless entry, power windows and locks, tri zone climate control, second and third row sunshades, and plenty of power outlets for charging devices.

Up front, Uconnect 8.4 handles the main infotainment duties, while SiriusXM, Bluetooth, steering wheel controls, a rear backup camera, and the upgraded Alpine system keep the driver connected and entertained.

Safety equipment includes Blind Spot Monitoring, Rear Cross Path Detection, ParkSense rear parking assist with stop, traction control, electronic stability control, and a full complement of airbags.

This Pacifica is not trying to be flashy. It is built to make family life easier. Heated seats in two rows, Stow n Go, rear entertainment, hands free doors, a power liftgate, and three row versatility all matter a lot more when you actually use the vehicle every day.

The last owners simply wanted something newer. If your priority is getting a comfortable, well equipped family hauler with a lot of useful features and a straightforward local trade story, this Pacifica Touring L Plus deserves a look.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.

description: COMPACT, EFFICIENT, PRACTICAL, WORK-READY, NONSMOKER, BUILT TO KEEP YOUR BUSINESS MOVING! The 2022 Ram ProMaster City proves that a work van does not have to be big to carry a lot, and this Bright White Tradesman, with the odometer reading 53,233 miles, pairs 131.7 cubic feet of cargo space and a 1,890-pound payload rating with a body that is easy to park and efficient to run. Black cloth seats, a perforated steel partition behind them and Uconnect 3 NAV navigation round out a cab that is ready for the work day. Under the hood, a 2.4-liter Tigershark MultiAir four-cylinder makes 178 horsepower and 174 lb-ft of torque and sends it through a 9-speed automatic transmission to the front wheels. Front-wheel drive keeps the weight over the drive wheels for steady traction on wet roads and helps keep the load floor low and easy to step into, and the EPA rates this van at 21 miles per gallon in the city, 28 on the highway and 24 combined. The history shows steady care. CARFAX lists 20 service history records, including regular oil and filter changes, a brake check in October 2024, replacement of the A/C compressor, condenser and expansion valve in 2025 and a maintenance inspection in September 2026. Inspection findings are explained in the disclosure near the end of this description, and we encourage a professional inspection before you buy. Why Shoppers Buy This Model The ProMaster City is Ram's compact van, built for businesses that need real cargo room in a size that fits tight streets, narrow driveways and ordinary parking spaces. KBB's review lists its strong yet efficient engine, easy driving manners, class-leading cargo capacity and 1,900-pound payload among its strengths, and Edmunds highlights a payload rating higher than most rivals and a large, versatile cargo area. Shoppers typically cross-shop the ProMaster City with the Ford Transit Connect and the Mercedes-Benz Metris. Many choose the Ram for its cargo volume, its payload and a price that makes sense for a working van. Automotive Press and Industry Recognition KBB's review of the ProMaster City points to a strong yet efficient engine, an easy-to-drive character, class-leading cargo capacity and a 1,900-pound payload, and Edmunds lists a higher payload rating than most rivals, a large and versatile cargo area and an engine with respectable power and efficiency among its highlights. Warranty The odometer on this ProMaster City currently reads 53,233 miles. This ProMaster City is STILL COVERED by transferable Ram factory warranty protection, measured from an estimated in-service date of March 2022. Remaining Transferable Factory Coverage: Powertrain Limited Warranty: 5 years or 60,000 miles, whichever comes first, running through March 2027 with 6,767 miles remaining, so any concerns can be addressed by a dealer while coverage is still in place. Corrosion Perforation Limited Warranty: 5 years with unlimited mileage, running through March 2027, subject to Ram's warranty conditions. Extended service plans are available for owners who want protection beyond these factory terms. Standard Features The Tradesman is the working heart of the ProMaster City lineup, with air conditioning, power windows, remote keyless entry, cruise control, a tilt and telescoping steering column, 60/40 split rear doors, 16-inch steel wheels, rear parking sensors and a ParkView rear back-up camera. Daytime running lights and a body-color front fascia keep the van looking clean and professional, and the driver's seat armrest makes long days behind the wheel more comfortable. Installed Options This ProMaster City was ordered with the Tradesman Cargo Van Package and Uconnect 3 NAV, which add everyday convenience and navigation to a work-ready cargo van. Tradesman Cargo Van Package 24C Leather-Wrapped Steering Wheel Gives the driver a better grip and a more comfortable feel during long days on the road. Steering-Wheel-Mounted Audio Controls Keep music and calls within reach without taking your hands off the wheel. Cargo Tie-Down Loops Give you anchor points to strap down tools, equipment and freight. Standalone Features Uconnect 3 NAV with 5-Inch Touch Screen Display Puts navigation, voice control and Bluetooth connectivity in an easy-to-use dash display, which helps with route planning and hands-free calls between jobs. Aftermarket Equipment The photos show a perforated steel partition behind the front seats that separates the cab from the cargo area and helps keep loads from shifting forward, along with a trailer hitch receiver below the rear bumper. These items are shown as observed additions and do not appear on the factory option list, so buyers are encouraged to inspect them in person. Van Capability The figures below are Ram's published numbers for the ProMaster City cargo van, and the partition behind the seats and other equipment added to the cargo area can change the usable space. The 60/40 split rear doors and the sliding side door give you two ways to load, and the low step-in height keeps repeated stops easier on the knees. Cargo Volume: 131.7 cubic feet Cargo Floor Length: 87.2 inches, or about 7 feet 3 inches Cargo Width: up to 60.4 inches Width Between Wheel Wells: 48.4 inches Cargo Height: 51.8 inches Rear Door Opening: 48.6 inches wide by 47.4 inches high Sliding Side Door Opening: 25.8 inches wide by 43.6 inches high Step-In Height: 21.5 inches Overall Length: 187.1 inches Overall Width: 84.6 inches including mirrors Overall Height: about 74.2 inches Wheelbase: 122.4 inches Minimum Ground Clearance: 5.2 inches Turning Diameter: 42.0 feet Curb Weight: 3,500 pounds Gross Vehicle Weight Rating: 5,395 pounds Payload: 1,890 pounds Maximum Towing: up to 2,000 pounds when properly equipped KBB lists the 2,000-pound towing rating for a properly equipped ProMaster City. The hitch receiver seen in the photos is not itemized on the factory option list, so its rating should be verified before towing. Mechanical Features The 2.4-liter Tigershark MultiAir four-cylinder delivers 178 horsepower at 6,400 rpm and 174 lb-ft of torque at 3,800 rpm, and its 9-speed automatic transmission keeps shifts smooth and well matched to the engine. The EPA rates this front-wheel-drive van at 21 miles per gallon in the city, 28 on the highway and 24 combined, and a 16-gallon fuel tank gives it a highway range of roughly 448 miles between fill-ups. A MacPherson strut front suspension and power rack-and-pinion steering make the ProMaster City easy to place on crowded streets, and electronic roll mitigation, all-speed traction control and trailer sway damping help the van stay composed with a load on board. Exterior Features Bright White paint gives the ProMaster City a clean, professional look that suits its practical shape. Black body-side moldings, a black rear bumper with a step pad, rear parking sensors and 16-inch steel wheels with center caps give the van a sturdy, no-nonsense stance, and daytime running lights help you be seen. A sliding side door opens wide on tight streets and crowded job sites, and the 60/40 split rear doors make loading and unloading easy. Interior Features Step inside and the ProMaster City feels like a tidy, work-ready cabin. Black cloth bucket seats with gray center inserts, a driver's seat armrest, a leather-wrapped steering wheel with audio controls and a tilt and telescoping steering column keep the driving position comfortable, and air conditioning and power windows take the edge off long days. Behind the seats, a perforated steel partition separates the cab from the cargo area, and the load floor behind it is ready for shelving, bins, tools and freight. Infotainment & Technology A 5-inch Uconnect 3 NAV touch screen anchors the dash with navigation and an easy-to-use layout, and voice recognition and Bluetooth capability help you stay connected on the road. Hands-free functionality and phone compatibility should be verified with the manufacturer. A ParkView rear back-up camera and rear parking sensors make backing up to a loading dock or into a tight driveway far less stressful. Safety Features Electronic stability control, electronic roll mitigation, all-speed traction control, hill start assist, brake assist and trailer sway damping work in the background to help you stay aware and in control, while 4-wheel antilock brakes add a steadier feel when the van is loaded. These features are aids and do not replace attentive driving, and their operation should be verified with the manufacturer. A comprehensive airbag system that includes front side-curtain airbags adds another layer of protection, and a tire pressure monitoring system helps you spot a low tire early. ... and there's SO MUCH more! If available, vehicle files can be found above this description on our website, including the original brochure and window sticker! Please note that inspection findings on this ProMaster City identify the left A-pillar and the left apron as kinked, with each classified as structural. The A-pillar is the structural roof support that runs alongside the driver's side of the windshield, and the apron is the structural inner-fender panel on the driver's side of the engine compartment that helps tie the front suspension to the body. Repair has not been confirmed, so we strongly recommend a professional inspection by a qualified body shop before purchase, along with a review of the full CARFAX report. The Bottom Line This ProMaster City offers a lot of working room for the money: 131.7 cubic feet of cargo space, a 1,890-pound payload rating, a 178-horsepower four-cylinder with a 9-speed automatic transmission, navigation, a cab-to-cargo partition and Ram powertrain coverage that runs into 2027. Because inspection findings identify structural items on the left front of the van, buyers should review the disclosure above and obtain the recommended inspection, and we are happy to go over every detail. A hardworking little van that deserves a close look in person. We will happily evaluate your TRADE-IN and offer EXCELLENT FINANCE OPTIONS as well, so please give us a call at 732-919-0707 (Wall Township) or 856-881-2869 (Sewell) TODAY!

description:
The 2022 Ford Transit Connect Cargo Van XL Van 4D represents the purpose-built, fleet-focused commercial utility specification of Ford s compact work van lineup. Built on Ford s C1 global unibody platform, the Transit Connect XL pairs high city maneuverability, a tight turning radius, and low step-in height with heavy-duty cargo volume, dual sliding side doors, and customizable upfitting utility.

Under the short front hood sits Ford s naturally aspirated 2.0-liter GDI DOHC 16-valve Inline 4-cylinder enginefeaturing Gasoline Direct Injection and Twin Independent Variable Camshaft Timing (Ti-VCT). This commercial engine produces 162 horsepower at 6,200 RPM and 144 lb-ft of torque at 4,500 RPM (a fleet-optioned 2.5-liter iVCT 4-cylinder engine producing 169 hp / 171 lb-ft was also available with CNG/LPG prep). Power is routed exclusively to the front wheels (FWD) through an 8-speed SelectShift automatic transmission (or 6-speed automatic with the 2.5L engine) featuring Auto Start-Stop technology to minimize idle fuel consumption. Supported by an independent MacPherson strut front suspension, a heavy-duty twist-beam rear axle with coil springs, Electric Power-Assisted Steering (EPAS), and 4-wheel power disc brakes with ABS (11.8-inch front / 11.0-inch rear rotors), the 3,594-lb Transit Connect XL LWB accelerates from 0 to 60 MPH in 10.1 seconds.

On the exterior, the 2022 XL trim is engineered for commercial durability, featuring unpainted black front and rear bumpers, a molded-in-black front grille, automatic halogen headlamps with auto-on/off, power-adjustable heated side mirrors with black caps, dual manual sliding side cargo doors, and standard 180-degree swing-out rear cargo doors with no glass (or optional rear liftgate). Available in Short Wheelbase (SWB) or Long Wheelbase (LWB) formats, the work van maintains a functional stance rolling on standard 16-inch heavy-duty steel wheels with full wheel covers (or optional center caps) wrapped in P215/55R16 all-season tires.

Inside, the driver-centric 2-passenger cabin is trimmed for utility with durable Vinyl seating upholstery (or optional commercial-grade Cloth) and a heavy-duty vinyl floor covering spanning the cab and cargo area for easy cleaning.Front occupants enjoy a 6-way manually adjustable driver seat and 4-way manual front passenger seat (with available fold-flat passenger seatback to serve as a mobile work desk). Interior appointments include Manual Air Conditioning,a tilt and telescoping steering column, 4.2-inch LCD Multi-Function display center, overhead storage shelf, power windows with driver one-touch down, power door locks, remote keyless entry, 12V power outlets, and a 110V AC household outlet option. Digital connectivity centers around an AM/FM stereo system with Bluetooth hands-free phone integration and audio streaming, a USB port, FordPass Connect with 4G LTE Wi-Fi hotspot capability (supporting telemetry and fleet management), Rear View Camera, and a 4-speaker audio layout.

Practicality and spatial allocation are class-leading highlights, particularly in the Long Wheelbase (LWB) setup spanning a 120.6-inch wheelbase layout (104.8-inch for SWB). Opening the 180-degree rear cargo doors reveals a wide, flat load floor with 127.4 cubic feet of maximum cargo volume behind the front seats on LWB models (104.8 cubic feet on SWB). Floor-to-ceiling interior cargo height reaches 49.8 inches with a flat load length of up to 87.8 inches behind the front seats, yielding a maximum payload capacity of 1,550 lbs (1,510 lbs on SWB).

Backed by a 15.8-gallon fuel tank, the 2.0L 4-cylinder FWD model achieves an EPA-estimated 24 MPG city, 28 MPG highway, and 26 MPG combined. When properly equipped with the factory Trailer Tow Package, maximum conventional towing capacity reaches 2,000 lbs. Safety engineering is anchored by standard Ford Co-Pilot360 technology including Pre-Collision Assist with Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB) and Pedestrian Detection,Forward Collision Warning, and Dynamic Brake Support. Additional safety features include AdvanceTrac with Roll Stability Control (RSC ), Side-Wind Stabilization, Hill Start Assist, Tire Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS), and a multi-stage 6-airbag canopy network including dual-stage front airbags, seat-mounted side airbags, and side curtain airbags.
